# Pandamonium v1.0.40

Continue a task already open in Codex, steer a running conversation, and read the final answer without a stack of progress bubbles. Pasted links are compact in the composer, and model/reasoning controls take less space.

## MAD-877 — Friday: repair live-task messaging and compact conversation presentation

### Problem

Desktop-owned tasks rejected continuation with an active-writer error. New conversations showed an empty assistant card and Opened task wrapper. Loaded commentary appeared as separate final answers. The reasoning selector was oversized, and pasted composer links stayed raw.

### Implementation

The bridge routes desktop-owned continuation and steering through the existing owner, checking the exact allowlisted project and native task. It observes native completion timestamps and retains the last final answer when steering produces multiple answers. No lock is removed and no task is duplicated. Connection errors do not automatically resend input.

The conversation groups visible commentary and tool activity under Worked, keeps the final answer visible, and removes empty assistant/task-opening wrappers. Compact native model and effort selects reuse the supported catalog options. The composer reuses sent-message rich links, preserves exact URLs for submission/copy, and uses native browser editing for undo/redo. Multiline paste stays in the draft on mobile.

### Product value and UI visibility

Select an existing Codex task and send a continuation from the composer. Running tasks receive steering; model and effort choices apply to the next turn. Expand Worked to see visible activity. Paste a web link to get the same compact presentation as a sent link, or double-click the chip to edit its URL. Controls and conversation styling follow the selected theme on desktop and phone.

### Verification

A disposable desktop-owned task continued on the same native task and recalled its prior context. Active steering returned the requested corrected answer. Native recorded context retained the requested read-only sandbox, model and effort. The test task used no tools or workspace writes and was archived after verification.

Regression checks cover private owner transport, response correlation, no replay on errors, turn completion timing, final-answer selection, exact URL submission/copy, native undo/redo, safe multiline paste, mobile containment, and compact history/selector presentation. Full suites and signed artifact verification are recorded in the implementation PR.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Update both Pandamonium and the workstation Codex bridge. Preserve the bridge's private token, environment, workspace allowlist and Codex home. Its existing two-file bundle remains unchanged in structure. Restart only while bridge tasks are idle, with the prior bundle retained for rollback. An app/container update does not replace a separately installed workstation bridge.

Desktop-owned continuation uses a versioned internal Codex Desktop IPC surface. Unsupported versions or disconnected owners fail visibly without automatic replay; inspect the native task before resending after an uncertain outcome. Active steering inherits that task's current native settings. An observation timeout does not stop the desktop task. Private reasoning, raw tool arguments, secrets and binary attachments are not exposed by history rendering. No dependency or schema change is required.
